name: Poisson weak scaling on 3D cuboid
description:
Weak scaling test for Poisson equation on a 3D cuboid.
The manufactured solution is a simple product of sines and cosines.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set in direction x.
slurm_script_str:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: poisson_cube_weak_scaling (2 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Weak scaling of the Poisson model with a manufactured solution on a 3D cuboid. The grid grows in x with the MPI rank count."
echo "Physics problem: Occurs in many plasma applications."
echo "Struphy model used: Poisson"
echo "Case directory: /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260822T100111Z-e093e316/poisson_cube_weak_scaling"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260822T100111Z-e093e316/poisson_cube_weak_scaling/sim_02"
cp "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/cube_weak_scaling/params_poisson.py" "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260822T100111Z-e093e316/poisson_cube_weak_scaling/parameters.py"

echo "Running poisson_cube_weak_scaling with 2 MPI ranks"
cd "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260822T100111Z-e093e316/poisson_cube_weak_scaling"
mpirun -n 2 /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/python /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/cube_weak_scaling/params_poisson.py --id 2 --cells-per-rank 64 > "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260822T100111Z-e093e316/poisson_cube_weak_scaling/sim_02/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: poisson_cube_weak_scaling (2 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
